answer: Delayed vesting with clawback: every reward an agent earns is held for ten epochs before it can be spent. During that voyage, random audits re-run a sample of its work, and if a clone ring is found, every unvested reward across the linked identities is clawed back. An attacker running 300 fakes must fund all their costs up front and wait out the delay, and one audit hit wipes the ring's whole pending summit of earnings. Honest agents only notice a small timing delta between earning and spending.
